schema_binding: platform seam draft through r2.10; S3/S4 pending build

cases.name: identity-existing
cases.arrange_and_action: Use a designated fixture member credential
cases.assertion: Identity matches that member and swarm; no new member created
cases.acceptance_level_required: L1 disposable host; later L2 separately

cases.name: identity-revoked
cases.arrange_and_action: Use invalid, expired and revoked disposable credentials
cases.assertion: Requests are refused without access or effects
cases.acceptance_level_required: L1 disposable host; later L2 separately

cases.name: invite-concurrent
cases.arrange_and_action: Redeem one disposable invitation concurrently
cases.assertion: At most one active identity created; losers do not retain authority
cases.acceptance_level_required: L1 disposable host; later L2 separately
cases.host_route: existing disposable harness invitation redemption; no new S3 enrollment API

cases.name: inventory-load
cases.arrange_and_action: Discover fixture member capabilities
cases.assertion: Receipt binds boot/process, source and inventory freshness; callable is structural and does not establish provider, budget or successful execution. Dynamic flow-skill definitions carry registry_revision separately from boot-registered skills; fixed Flow tool set.
cases.acceptance_level_required: L1 disposable host; later L2 separately

cases.name: inventory-states
cases.arrange_and_action: Compare declared, loaded, callable, denied and unavailable fixtures
cases.assertion: Configured/imported/callable/unknown and policy states stay distinct; no boot receipt means null inventory_revision and loaded_at, no-boot-receipt availability and all skills unknown.
cases.acceptance_level_required: L1 disposable host; later L2 separately

cases.name: inventory-private
cases.arrange_and_action: Ask member A for member B or operator-only inventory
cases.assertion: Refuse or filter private resources; credentials never returned
cases.acceptance_level_required: L1 disposable host; later L2 separately

cases.name: query-scope
cases.arrange_and_action: Query own, granted and ungranted fixture commons
cases.assertion: Only permitted scope returned; client cannot select another actor
cases.acceptance_level_required: L1 disposable host; later L2 separately

cases.name: query-envelope
cases.arrange_and_action: Query observed, derived and unknown-TV fixtures
cases.assertion: Host returns one validated Atom snapshot per granted scope with complete lineage closure, including nonmatching premises; pages split closure groups, at most 200 records, explicit completeness and terminal cursor markers. R2.6: host reuses Atom project_pages; include withdrawal controls and controls on controls; oversized complete group refuses the call, never partial lineage.
cases.acceptance_level_required: L1 disposable host; later L2 separately

cases.name: query-repeated
cases.arrange_and_action: Repeat an identical fixture query
cases.assertion: Evidence IDs stable; repeated reads do not add evidence or inflate confidence Cited evidence must be an exact stamp member; wildcard and pattern identities refused.
cases.acceptance_level_required: L1 disposable host; later L2 separately

cases.name: result-data
cases.arrange_and_action: Finish a held bound goal with typed structured data
cases.assertion: Bound goal requires top-level binding_digest, current claimant and declared result schema; exact full-payload retry is idempotent, conflicting nested binding refused.
cases.acceptance_level_required: L1 disposable host; later L2 separately

cases.name: result-wrong-binding
cases.arrange_and_action: Change binding or submit as wrong assignee
cases.assertion: Refused; goal remains without unauthorized result
cases.acceptance_level_required: L1 disposable host; later L2 separately

cases.name: result-retry
cases.arrange_and_action: Retry identical then differing completed result
cases.assertion: Identical recovery succeeds without duplicate effect; differing payload refused
cases.acceptance_level_required: L1 disposable host; later L2 separately

cases.name: heartbeat-holder
cases.arrange_and_action: Renew a valid held goal then renew as another member
cases.assertion: Heartbeat cannot reopen terminal work or extend source grant; effective deadline is minimum of source, requested and granted deadline.
cases.acceptance_level_required: L1 disposable host; later L2 separately

cases.name: lease-deadline
cases.arrange_and_action: Advance fixture time across lease and hard deadline
cases.assertion: Matches internal expiry/reopen behaviour; hard deadline cannot be bypassed
cases.acceptance_level_required: L1 disposable host; later L2 separately

cases.name: cancel-ack
cases.arrange_and_action: Cancel held goal, acknowledge and send late result
cases.assertion: Ack recorded; revoked exhibits denied; late result refused
cases.acceptance_level_required: L1 disposable host; later L2 separately

cases.name: read-resource-scope
cases.arrange_and_action: Read own, granted and foreign exhibit/artifact fixtures
cases.assertion: Authenticate identity and grant before digest mismatch details; expected_digest required; no read creates derive/share authority.
cases.acceptance_level_required: L1 disposable host; later L2 separately

cases.name: read-pages-digest
cases.arrange_and_action: Read paged exhibit and digest-addressed artifact
cases.assertion: Exact retained revision remains readable when latest changes; require_current optionally refuses stale; digest and cursor binding maintained across bounded pages and assets.
cases.acceptance_level_required: L1 disposable host; later L2 separately

cases.name: read-revoked
cases.arrange_and_action: Revoke fixture grant after first page
cases.assertion: Revocation is rechecked on every page, asset and cached resource access; opaque cursor expires at 10 minutes or earlier grant expiry.
cases.acceptance_level_required: L1 disposable host; later L2 separately

cases.name: publish-identity
cases.arrange_and_action: Submit evidence with spoofed owner/scope
cases.assertion: Host issues evidence identity and authenticates publisher/scope; personal/health publication into S1 shared commons refused.
cases.acceptance_level_required: L1 disposable host; later L2 separately

cases.name: publish-envelope
cases.arrange_and_action: Submit malformed, derived and absent-TV envelopes
cases.assertion: Use accepted OmegaAtom 0.1 validator; unknown true omits f/c, null or truth plus unknown refused; host projects admitted premise closure; atomic batch add-as-data, stamp, envelope and aggregate. Host uses stage_append and lineage_delta; actor issues only under own evidence:write/token; canonical Atom and Learn hashes labelled separately.
cases.acceptance_level_required: L1 disposable host; later L2 separately

cases.name: publish-duplicate
cases.arrange_and_action: Repeat source and submit overlapping evidence
cases.assertion: Canonical payload retry retains one host-issued stamp across restart; changed payload with same idempotency key conflicts; overlapping support is not independent; retraction and retraction-of-retraction preserve lineage.
cases.acceptance_level_required: L1 disposable host; later L2 separately

cases.name: planner-request
cases.arrange_and_action: Submit a synthetic versioned plan through declared route
cases.assertion: Typed service/swarm destination; request_id and goal_id returned; exact revision/digest bound and Planner result schema referenced. Required from_goal, title and idempotency_key; optional exact contract; retry creates no second receiving goal or budget allocation.
cases.acceptance_level_required: L1 disposable host; later L2 separately

cases.name: planner-return
cases.arrange_and_action: Read typed plan-check result
cases.assertion: Result preserves request/revision/digest and separates transport validation from semantic acceptance Findings include whole, scene/element and page targets bound to exact revision. Enabled validator is selected only by host-stored request binding.validate; reviewer context is read-only. Missing/disabled hook permits whole only; async timeout/exception refuses with validator_unavailable.
cases.acceptance_level_required: L1 disposable host; later L2 separately

cases.name: planner-stale
cases.arrange_and_action: Change plan revision before result returns
cases.assertion: Old result cannot promote or approve new revision
cases.acceptance_level_required: L1 disposable host; later L2 separately

cases.name: policy-parity
cases.arrange_and_action: Exercise same allowed/ask/denied fixture action via MCP and internal route
cases.assertion: Full actor, capability, resource, binding, grant, approval and effect policy context yields equivalent authority decisions over MCP and native route. Security regressions: later Never overrides earlier Always; equally specific ties are restrictive; high-risk standing Always refused by server.
cases.acceptance_level_required: L1 disposable host; later L2 separately
cases.policy_mapping: r2.4 native policy-name table; parity requires full context

cases.name: approval-binding
cases.arrange_and_action: Alter connection, resource, capability or input after fixture approval
cases.assertion: Previous approval cannot authorize modified action Bundle import cannot grant authority or alter another mind; memory must be atoms only. Narrowed code capability cannot widen through input, and unknown fields refused.
cases.acceptance_level_required: L1 disposable host; later L2 separately

cases.name: read-only-no-effects
cases.arrange_and_action: Perform identity, discovery and query calls
cases.assertion: No publication, subscriptions, execution, approvals or new grants
cases.acceptance_level_required: L1 disposable host; later L2 separately

cases.name: malformed-limits
cases.arrange_and_action: Send malformed JSON, wrong argument types and oversized inputs
cases.assertion: Structured bounded refusals without partial action
cases.acceptance_level_required: L1 disposable host; later L2 separately

cases.name: schema-drift
cases.arrange_and_action: Use incompatible host/tool schema version or changed capability version
cases.assertion: Protocol 2025-06-18, server version 0.2.0 and tools/list result._meta x-hive-schema s3-r1 checked against build-published full schemas before dispatch.
cases.acceptance_level_required: L1 disposable host; later L2 separately

cases.name: timeout-reconcile
cases.arrange_and_action: Lose response after fixture mutating operation committed
cases.assertion: Client reconciles by request identity; no blind repeat or fabricated success
cases.acceptance_level_required: L1 disposable host; later L2 separately
